# Scalar oracle for fixed3d: frozen HASH lines from the plain scalar build
# (no BOX3D_AVX512, no BOX3D_NEON), one per scene x workers {1,2,4} x
# {narrow, ludicrous}. The oracle is REGENERATED by oracle_check.sh --regenerate
# and refused unless two runs on the scalar build agree. It proves a candidate
# build did not change a bit.
#
# Format: HASH <scene> workers=<n> <mode> <16 hex>
# (mode is 'narrow' or 'ludicrous')
#
# TODO: populate by running oracle_check.sh --regenerate on the scalar build.
